facts.text: TargetTrackingBase is the Gymnasium environment class and derives from gym.Env
TargetTrackingBase constructs the world from the world class, map and viewport flag, stores the config, and takes its action and observation spaces from the world
auv_env.make builds TargetTrackingBase(world_class, map_name, show_viewport, config, **kwargs)
The make factory's t_steps parameter defaults to 100
auv_env.make wraps the environment in gym.wrappers.TimeLimit(max_episode_steps=t_steps)
AUVTracking_v0 selects WorldAuvV0, the SimpleUnderwater-Bluerov2 map and ../configs/envs/v0_config.yml
The v1-state gym.register block is commented out
When no config is passed, make loads the cwd-relative default by config_loader.load_config
WorldAuvV0 is the state-only world
WorldBase creates the scene with holoocean.make(self.map, show_viewport=show)
WorldBase derives the sampling period as 1/scenario['ticks_per_sec'] from the HoloOcean scenario
WorldBase computes ticks_per_rl_step from the controller frequency and the sampling period
TargetTrackingBase.reset calls np.random.seed() with no argument before delegating to world.reset
WorldAuvV0.reset clears its reward and action queues before calling WorldBase.reset
get_init_pose_random calls np.random.seed() with no argument inside its outer initial-pose sampling loop
TargetTrackingBase.step delegates to world.step(action=action)
WorldBase.step loops over ticks_per_rl_step iterations
WorldBase.step calls self.ocean.tick()
WorldBase.step returns (state, reward, done, 0, info)
WorldBase.reset teleports auv0 and each target to the sampled poses and ticks the ocean once
WorldBase.reset returns (state, info) with info {'reset_info': 'yes'}
WorldBase.reset prints the sampled agent and target poses
TargetTrackingBase.seed calls np.random.seed(seed)
The shipped v0 config selects the PID controller
The PID controller config has action_dim 2 and control_frequency 5
WorldAuvV0.set_limits builds the PID action space from config action_range_low[1] and action_range_high[1]
The shipped v0 PID action range is low [-1, -1] and high [1, 1] with scale [1.5, 0.5]
The PID step sets CmdVel.linear.x to action[0] times action_range_scale[0] and CmdVel.angular.z to action[1] times action_range_scale[1]
The v0 state is [target-belief distance, target-belief bearing, log determinant of the covariance, observed flag] per target, then [nearest obstacle distance, nearest obstacle angle]
The v0 observation space is Box(6) with lower [0, -pi, -50, 0, 0, -pi] and upper [600, pi, 50, 2, sensor_r, pi] for one target
The v0 reward is c_mean * r_detcov_mean + c_std * r_detcov_std + c_smooth * r_action_smooth and, on a collision, min(0, reward) - c_penalty
The v0 reward defaults are c_mean 0.2, c_std 0.0, c_smooth 1.0 and c_penalty 5.0
WorldAuvV0 keeps the last 100 rewards in a deque(maxlen=100)
The episode is done when the 100-entry reward deque is full and its mean is below -3.5
The v0 config sets num_targets 1, margin 1.0 and margin2wall 1.0
The v0 config sets sensor_r 4.0 and fov 100
The README requires HoloOcean 2.0.0 and copying the configs/holoocean scenarios into the HoloOcean worlds directory
The README documents gym.make('AUVTracking_v0') as the registration path

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its own random.Random from reset(seed) and is deterministic for one seed and action sequence; the upstream reset reseeds numpy from entropy (BASE:47, BASE:463), so a seed passed to reset or seed does not fix a HoloOcean trajectory

fidelity.engine: analytic: AUVTracking_v0 target-tracking stand-in (no HoloOcean, PID, LQR or KF belief)
gaps: no HoloOcean physics, water, ocean current, PID or LQR controller, KF belief, sonar, camera or obstacles: the fake moves a point with the PID action scale and a fixed placeholder interval, and the target is static

the covariance determinant, the observed flag, the rewards and the initial poses are analytic stand-ins; they follow the shape of WorldAuvV0 (V0:78-107, V0:109-133) but not its numbers or its belief update

the initial poses are drawn from the v0 map bounds; the upstream draws them through get_init_pose_random with obstacle, margin and insight rejection loops (BASE:454-533) that the fake does not reproduce

the upstream sampling period is 1/scenario['ticks_per_sec'] of the HoloOcean scenario (BASE:78) and one RL step integrates ticks_per_rl_step of them (BASE:110-118); the fake advances one abstract step and reports timestep_ms 0

the deployed env is auv_env.make, which wraps TargetTrackingBase in a TimeLimit of t_steps (INIT:53); the driver serves the class, so the fake implements only the environment's own done rule and never truncates

no live backend was run: the clone registers no Gymnasium id (INIT:125-129), the constructor needs HoloOcean, the HoloOcean Ocean packages and the copied scenario files (README:48-53), and package code never imports the clone

upstream reset samples initial poses in an outer loop with no attempt or time bound (auv_env/envs/base.py:454-533); it prints poses to stdout (base.py:383-384), which would need isolation from an MHS stdio server; the fake neither launches nor stops a HoloOcean process

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the fake simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation, reward and tick stay readable; the latch calls nothing in HoloOcean and this package declares only the fake backend
